question.prompt: Name a song with space, a planet, the Moon, stars or rockets in its title.
question.criteria: Any commercially released song whose title contains “space,” a planet’s name, “moon,” “star” or “rocket,” including plurals and compound words.

answers.evidence: Space Oddity is a David Bowie song that introduces the fictional astronaut Major Tom.

aliases: Rocket Man (I Think It's Going to Be a Long, Long Time)
answers.evidence: Rocket Man is a song by Elton John.
Fly Me to the Moon is a popular standard famously recorded by Frank Sinatra.
Counting Stars is a song by OneRepublic.
A Sky Full of Stars is a song by Coldplay.
Life on Mars? is a song by David Bowie.
Drops of Jupiter is a song by Train.
Venus is a Shocking Blue song that was later covered by Bananarama.
Saturn is a song by SZA.
Moon River is a song performed by Audrey Hepburn in Breakfast at Tiffany's.
Blue Moon is a standard written by Richard Rodgers and Lorenz Hart and recorded by many artists.
Bad Moon Rising is a song by Creedence Clearwater Revival.
Walking on the Moon is a song by the Police.
Man on the Moon is a song by R.E.M.
Space Cowboy is a song by Jamiroquai.
Talking to the Moon is a song by Bruno Mars.
All the Stars is a song by Kendrick Lamar and SZA from the Black Panther soundtrack.
Starman is a song by David Bowie.
Earth Song is a song by Michael Jackson.
Space Truckin' is a song by Deep Purple.
Space Is the Place is the title track of an album by Sun Ra.

question.explanation: These titles span pop, rock, jazz and R&B, from lunar standards to songs named after planets. Different songs sharing a title count as the same typed answer.
